metadata.name: COBALIFNeuron
metadata.author: Brette, R. et al.
metadata.description: Brette et al. Benchmark 1 conductance-based LIF cell with the maintained coupled RK4 and absolute refractory schedule

dynamics.v: (v_reset if refractory_time > 0.0 else (v_reset if (base_v + (dt / 6.0) * (weighted_v + ((-g_l * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_l) - ((base_ge + dt * last_k_ge) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_e) + (base_gi + dt * last_k_gi) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_i)) + I) / c_m))) >= v_threshold else (base_v + (dt / 6.0) * (weighted_v + ((-g_l * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_l) - ((base_ge + dt * last_k_ge) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_e) + (base_gi + dt * last_k_gi) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_i)) + I) / c_m))))) if phase > 2.5 else v
dynamics.g_e: base_ge + (dt / 6.0) * (weighted_ge + (-(base_ge + dt * last_k_ge) / tau_e)) if phase > 2.5 else g_e
dynamics.g_i: base_gi + (dt / 6.0) * (weighted_gi + (-(base_gi + dt * last_k_gi) / tau_i)) if phase > 2.5 else g_i
dynamics.refractory_time: ((0.0 if refractory_time <= dt * (1.0 + 1.0e-12) else refractory_time - dt) if refractory_time > 0.0 else (refractory_period if (base_v + (dt / 6.0) * (weighted_v + ((-g_l * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_l) - ((base_ge + dt * last_k_ge) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_e) + (base_gi + dt * last_k_gi) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_i)) + I) / c_m))) >= v_threshold else 0.0)) if phase > 2.5 else refractory_time
dynamics.spike_flag: (0.0 if refractory_time > 0.0 else (1.0 if (base_v + (dt / 6.0) * (weighted_v + ((-g_l * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_l) - ((base_ge + dt * last_k_ge) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_e) + (base_gi + dt * last_k_gi) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_i)) + I) / c_m))) >= v_threshold else 0.0)) if phase > 2.5 else spike_flag
dynamics.last_k_v: 0.0 if refractory_time > 0.0 else (((-g_l * (v - e_l) - ((g_e + delta_ge) * (v - e_e) + (g_i + delta_gi) * (v - e_i)) + I) / c_m) if phase < 0.5 else (((-g_l * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_l) - ((base_ge + dt * last_k_ge) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_e) + (base_gi + dt * last_k_gi) * ((base_v + dt * last_k_v) - e_i)) + I) / c_m) if phase > 2.5 else ((-g_l * ((base_v + 0.5 * dt * last_k_v) - e_l) - ((base_ge + 0.5 * dt * last_k_ge) * ((base_v + 0.5 * dt * last_k_v) - e_e) + (base_gi + 0.5 * dt * last_k_gi) * ((base_v + 0.5 * dt * last_k_v) - e_i)) + I) / c_m)))
dynamics.last_k_ge: (-(g_e + delta_ge) / tau_e) if phase < 0.5 else ((-(base_ge + dt * last_k_ge) / tau_e) if phase > 2.5 else (-(base_ge + 0.5 * dt * last_k_ge) / tau_e))
dynamics.last_k_gi: (-(g_i + delta_gi) / tau_i) if phase < 0.5 else ((-(base_gi + dt * last_k_gi) / tau_i) if phase > 2.5 else (-(base_gi + 0.5 * dt * last_k_gi) / tau_i))
dynamics.weighted_v: 0.0 if refractory_time > 0.0 else (((-g_l * (v - e_l) - ((g_e + delta_ge) * (v - e_e) + (g_i + delta_gi) * (v - e_i)) + I) / c_m) if phase < 0.5 else (weighted_v + 2.0 * ((-g_l * ((base_v + 0.5 * dt * last_k_v) - e_l) - ((base_ge + 0.5 * dt * last_k_ge) * ((base_v + 0.5 * dt * last_k_v) - e_e) + (base_gi + 0.5 * dt * last_k_gi) * ((base_v + 0.5 * dt * last_k_v) - e_i)) + I) / c_m) if phase < 2.5 else weighted_v))
dynamics.weighted_ge: (-(g_e + delta_ge) / tau_e) if phase < 0.5 else (weighted_ge + 2.0 * (-(base_ge + 0.5 * dt * last_k_ge) / tau_e) if phase < 2.5 else weighted_ge)
dynamics.weighted_gi: (-(g_i + delta_gi) / tau_i) if phase < 0.5 else (weighted_gi + 2.0 * (-(base_gi + 0.5 * dt * last_k_gi) / tau_i) if phase < 2.5 else weighted_gi)

extensions.source_equations: Brette et al. (2007), Appendix 2, Benchmark 1: conductance-based integrate-and-fire cell.
extensions.discretisation: The source continuous equations are advanced by one maintained four-stage classical RK4 macro step. method=map plus integration.substeps=4 carries the explicit stage registers without integrating the stage recurrences again.
extensions.event_order: At stage 0 apply boundary delta_ge and delta_gi; evaluate RK4 stages 1-4; hold voltage and RK4-decay conductances while refractory; at stage 4 validate and compare the raw candidate, set spike_flag, reset voltage, and load refractory_period.
extensions.refractory_contract: The timer updates only after stage 4 and clamps at dt with a 1e-12 relative roundoff guard, so the 5 ms interval at dt=0.1 contains exactly 50 held macro steps without a floating-point residue step.
extensions.conductance_event_contract: delta_ge and delta_gi are schema parameters representing constant per-macro-step boundary events; event-driven Python callers may vary them on each public step.
extensions.auxiliary_state_contract: spike_flag, phase, base_*, last_k_*, and weighted_* are deterministic RK4/event lowering registers, not biological state. Four internal map substeps are folded into one public macro step and one rising spike_flag decision.
